description: This Java class handles the command for approving share product dividends within the Fineract project. It implements a handler that processes the 'APPROVE_DIVIDEND' command for share products, invoking the appropriate service method.

classes.name: ApproveShareProductDividendCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles commands to approve share product dividends, identified by the 'APPROVE_DIVIDEND' action on 'SHAREPRODUCT' entities.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to approve a share product dividend by delegating to the shareProductWritePlatformService's approveShareProductDividend method.
